fusions.name: Peck by Rote
fusions.desc: A drilled peck that deals 7 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally beside you, up to 32%. It holds 5 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Note-Perfect Flurry
fusions.desc: Buffets every enemy within 3 tiles for 28 damage, and every hit is a critical hit. Your movement speed rises by 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Well-Worn Routine
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting, and you jink 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Practised Scramble
fusions.desc: Once every 12 seconds, a dodge that fails is rolled again and the second roll stands. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
